speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I see you are a newborn with increasing yellow discoloration of the eyes and skin; this suggests jaundice. To determine if this is physiological or pathological, how many hours after birth did the yellowing first become noticeable?

speaker: Patient
text: 2-week-old female newborn. The patient has been experiencing increasing yellow discoloration of her eyes and skin for 2 days. She was born at 39 weeks' gestation, initially weighed 3066 g and now weighs 3200 g. The patient is exclusively breastfed.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Breastfeeding Jaundice (also known as starvation jaundice or suboptimal intake jaundice).

The clinical picture of a 2-week-old, term, exclusively breastfed infant with worsening jaundice and stable weight gain is consistent with insufficient milk intake. I will order a total serum bilirubin level to confirm the severity and ensure it does not exceed the threshold for phototherapy. REQUEST TEST: Total_Serum_Bilirubin.
